english.notes:
(i) Section 32(1) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 provides that this section applies to ships and aircraft which are:-
(a) arriving, or expected to arrive, in the United Kingdom, or
(b) leaving, or expected to leave, the United Kingdom.
(ii) Section 32(4) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 provides that a constable may impose a requirement under section 32(2) only if he thinks it necessary:-
(a) in the case of a constable in England, Wales or Northern Ireland, for police purposes, or
(b) in the case of a constable in Scotland, for police purposes which are or relate to reserved matters.
(iii) Section 32(5) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 provides that in this section:-
(a) "passenger or service information" means information which is of a kind specified by order of the Secretary of State and which relates to passengers, members of crew, or a voyage or flight,
(b) "police purposes" has the meaning given by section 21(3) of the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999 (disclosure by Secretary of State).
(iv) Section 32(6) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 provides that a requirement imposed under section 32(2):-
(a) must be in writing,
(b) may apply generally or only to one or more specified ships or aircraft,
(c) must specify a period, not exceeding six months and beginning with the date on which it is imposed, during which it has effect,
(d) must state the information required, and the date or time by which it is to be provided.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 51 weeks imprisonment and /or a fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

Note:
Section 34(4) of the Immigration, Asylum and Nationality Act 2006 provides that in relation to a conviction occurring before the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003, the reference to 51 weeks shall be taken as a reference to three months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
